_about: Fixed inputs for scripts/svartsengi_gnss.py, each with its source. Dates are UTC days.

inflation_intervals.name: I1
inflation_intervals.why: between events 8 and 9; VOGC starts 2024-09-30; AUSV gap Aug 2024 - Apr 2025

pre_unrest_window.why: SENG starts mid-2015; Svartsengi unrest began in January 2020 (Flovenz et al. 2022)

parks2025_source.source: Parks et al. 2025, EPSL 658:119324, doi:10.1016/j.epsl.2025.119324 (Mogi source used for their GNSS volume series)

imo_volumes.note: IMO news update of 21 July 2026: since the start of the eruption on 16 July 2025; 95 % range; end date of the data not stated, the update date is used
IMO news update of 18 August 2026; figure caption: 17 July 2025 to 16 August 2026; 95 % range

event_selection_rule.rule: an event's SENG volume loss is used only if the 5th percentile of the epicentral distance from SENG to the reviewed IMO earthquakes in the first 24 h after onset is >= 3.0 km
event_selection_rule.why: uses only the seismicity, not the GNSS losses or the published losses; written down on 2026-11-16 after the earlier (unblinded) selection of events 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11 had been seen
